label: DC
comment: original/danish.d64, file BRUCE LEE   (DC): Danish Crackers DC-011/P, TCS-CRUNCH packed. The game bytes are the TBC bytes, but the packed file ends at $F200: the demo input at $F300-$F538 is missing.

label: SAEGER
comment: original/saeger.d64, file BRUCE LEE: cracked in October 1984 by Saeger Soft Group (SSG). The image was saved from a game that had run: it holds the run state of the music player, a byte of an interrupted KERNAL RAM test at $9B00, and the edit DIABOLO PRESENTS.

label: TBC
comment: original/bruce_lee_tbc.prg: CRACKED BY TBC, with the Datasoft title picture as its intro. Same crack image as SAEGER (same relocator at $C000 and copies at $A000), saved before a run: no run state, no RAM-test byte, DATASOFT PRESENTS.
